objective: LungVision AI — Phase 6 Forensic Disease Prediction Failure Audit.
acceptance_criteria: Gate A: Checkpoint Integrity and Architecture Audit (Verify DenseNet121 weights SHA-256: 8d3690cd0438587a94afb8fd2ad84c0b30f9c1cc2727ee0eb03662a02ea020af, architecture configuration, state dict keys, classifier head, output dimension, export phase6_checkpoint_integrity.json).

Gate B: Image Inventory & Preprocessing Audit (Audit 6 test images in test/, metadata, dimensions, bit depth, color mode, aspect ratio, borders, orientation; audit backend preprocessor resize vs crop, normalization, channel replication, tensor statistics, export phase6_image_inventory.json and phase6_preprocessing_audit.json).

Gate C: Class Order & Output Mapping Audit (Trace class indexing across dataset labels, model head, XRayService LABELS_6_DISEASE, API response schema, and frontend UI components; verify order alignment; export phase6_class_order_audit.json).

Gate D: Probability & Threshold Audit (Audit logit to sigmoid transform, verify no double-sigmoid or softmax distortion, audit frozen NIH thresholds against calibration set, export phase6_probability_threshold_audit.json).
Gate E: Six Image Prediction Reproduction (Run reproducible inference on test/ images, record logits, probabilities, thresholds, binary decisions, latency, export phase6_six_image_predictions.json).

Gate F: Diagnostic Error Analysis (Classify each test image under standardized failure taxonomy: Expected Prediction, Possible False Negative, Possible False Positive, Multi-label Finding, Uncertain Reference, Out-of-Distribution, Preprocessing Failure, Inference Failure; explain physiological, radiological, and resolution-induced mechanisms; export phase6_image_error_analysis.json).

Gate G: Grad-CAM & Attention Explainability Audit (Compute layer Grad-CAM for all 6 test images across predicted and reference disease classes, evaluate anatomical grounding vs shortcut learning/text/border artifacts, generate overlay PNGs, export phase6_gradcam_analysis.json).
Gate H: Training Data & Class Imbalance Audit (Audit NIH ChestX-ray14 class distributions, co-occurrence matrix, positive-weight loss handling, label noise, export phase6_training_data_audit.json).

Gate I: Threshold Performance & Sensitivity/Specificity Analysis (Evaluate calibrated test set under frozen thresholds: AUROC, AUPRC, Sensitivity, Specificity, F1, Brier score, ECE; analyze clinical tradeoffs; export phase6_threshold_performance.json).

Gate J: Frontend-Backend Trace & End-to-End Pipeline Audit (Trace byte ingestion, base64 encoding/decoding, API transport, React state handling, precision formatting, potential race conditions or rendering bugs; export phase6_frontend_backend_trace.json).

Gate K: Controlled Fixes, Regression Testing & Authoritative Report (Implement safe minimal fixes if pipeline bugs identified, execute backend & frontend regression test suites, export phase6_regression_test_report.json, author comprehensive PHASE_6_FORENSIC_PREDICTION_FAILURE_REPORT.md).
non_goals: Do not modify or retrain frozen DenseNet121 production weights (SHA-256: 8d3690cd0438587a94afb8fd2ad84c0b30f9c1cc2727ee0eb03662a02ea020af)
Do not alter frozen NIH production classification thresholds
Do not overwrite Phase 5B, 5C, or 5D artifacts or delete 3D shape reconstruction checkpoints
Do not treat image filenames as verified clinical ground truth
Do not hide false positives or false negatives or distort model outputs
